name: samsung-tv
description: Discover, pair, and control Samsung Tizen TVs on a local network with a portable CLI and MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Discover Samsung Tizen TVs, inspect status, pair with on-screen approval, and send requested remote commands. Device selection, pairing tokens, optional input shortcuts, and external voice gateway settings stay in private local configuration.
